title: Design System: LyShell — Codex / Claude 工作区面板

system.purpose: 面板全文字体，沿用操作系统界面字体。

workspace-summary.purpose: 模型、变量组、权限、目录，11px 辅助色。

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: 折叠箭头旋转、启动按钮底色/文字过渡。

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: 系统偏好减少动画时关闭过渡。

breakpoints.name: harness-projects-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: 容器查询：窄于此值收窄内边距与启动按钮。

components.name: 项目章节头
components.description: 项目章节头：顶部 2px 项目色标，项目名 + 父目录 + 计数 + 折叠箭头。
components.html: my-projectD:\workspace\my-project3
components.css: .ds-project-group { --ds-project-color: color-mix(in srgb, hsl(200 36% 56%) 65%, var(--text-rack)); border-top: 2px solid var(--ds-project-color); font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-project-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 6px 8px; background: var(--bg-rack); color: var(--text-rack); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-project-symbol { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 18px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--ds-project-color); } .ds-project-heading { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; } .ds-project-label { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 20px; } .ds-project-parent { font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-rack) 76%, var(--bg-base)); } .ds-project-count { flex-shrink: 0; min-width: 18px; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; line-height: 20px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-rack) 76%, var(--bg-base)); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-project-chevron { flex-shrink: 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-rack) 76%, var(--bg-base)); transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-project-header:hover .ds-project-label { color: var(--ds-project-color); } .ds-project-symbol { display: none; }

components.name: 工作区行
components.description: 全宽 52px 工作区行：左侧名称/摘要，右侧常显启动按钮。
components.css: .ds-workspace-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 52px; padding: 0 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-rack) 12%, var(--bg-base)); background: transparent; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-workspace-row:hover { background: var(--bg-slot); } .ds-workspace-main { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 9px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 50px; padding: 5px 0; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-rack); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-workspace-symbol { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 18px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-rack) 76%, var(--bg-base)); } .ds-workspace-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-workspace-name { display: flex; align-items: baseline; font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; } .ds-workspace-prefix { flex: 0 1 auto; max-width: 38%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-rack) 76%, var(--bg-base)); } .ds-workspace-separator { flex-shrink: 0; padding: 0 4px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-rack) 76%, var(--bg-base)); } .ds-workspace-branch { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 550; } .ds-workspace-summary { font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-rack) 76%, var(--bg-base)); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-launch-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; flex-shrink: 0; min-width: 60px; height: 30px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--bg-rack); color: var(--text-rack); font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-launch-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-slot); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 45%, var(--text-rack)); border-color: var(--amber); } .ds-launch-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: 启动按钮
components.description: 工作区行右侧常显启动按钮：强调色 45% 描边，hover 底/字互换。
components.css: .ds-launch-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; flex-shrink: 0; min-width: 60px; height: 30px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--bg-rack); color: var(--text-rack); font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-launch-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-slot); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 45%, var(--text-rack)); border-color: var(--amber); } .ds-launch-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-launch-btn:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .45; }

narrative.overview: 项目是一级索引：先识别项目，再读工作区名称与模型、变量组，点击始终可见的启动按钮。工作区是可直接启动的全宽条目，取消树线与深缩进。本设计仅适用于 Codex 与 Claude 两个工作区面板，不替代 DeepSeek 面板或其他页面的设计规范。
keyCharacteristics: 全宽工作区与项目章节色标
面板底色和焦点色沿用全局主题
52px 统一行高，配置独立分层
dos: Do 使用全局主题面色和操作强调色。
Do 仅在分组色标与权限状态保留语义色。
donts: Don't 引入树线、深缩进或卡片外框/图标底座。
Don't 用脱离主题的固定面板色。
Don't 把这些规则套用到 DeepSeek 面板或其他页面——本设计仅约束 Codex / Claude 两个面板。
